management_remarks: Q3 FY26 delivered record consolidated quarterly profit for Reliance Industries, propelled by festive consumer demand in Retail and Jio ARPU reaching Rs 215.8. Our O2C segment benefitted from resilient domestic polymer demand and optimized feedstock sourcing, lifting sequential refining and petchem profitability. Initial solar module production lines at the Dhirubhai Ambani Green Energy Giga Complex achieved benchmark cell efficiency.
analyst_qa: In Q&A on New Energy payback periods, management noted that initial gigafactory ramp-up margins are subject to polysilicon price volatility and uncertain export tariff regimes. O2C polyester and polymer deltas face ongoing headwinds from regional supply additions, keeping near-term segment growth calibrated. Sustaining 20%-plus retail growth across a massive base is challenging and requires cautious inventory management.
